args.title: Tamarack Warehouse Automation 2026 — Combined Summary
args.body:
Summary of https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse and its subscriber companion piece (https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion):

• Warehouse automation in 2026: pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts.
• Integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: the biggest saving was fewer mis-picks.
